Multiplying two complex numbers is similar to multiplying two binomials. We also use the fact that $\textrm{i}^2 = -1.$

For the given problem, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}(1-3\,\text{i})(2+4\,\text{i}) & =1\cdot 2+1\cdot 4\,\text{i}+(-3\,\text{i})\cdot 2+(-3\,\text{i})\cdot 4\,\text{i} \\  & =2+4\,\text{i}-6\,\text{i}-12\,{\text{i}}^{2} \\  & =2-2\,\text{i}-12\cdot (-1) \\  & =2-2\,\text{i}+12 \\  & =14-2\,\text{i}.\end{aligned}
$$
